steps.sql: SELECT HASH("ORDER_ID", "USER_ID", "PRODUCT_ID", "QUANTITY", "ORDERED_AT") AS __kumo_order_0__, "ORDER_ID" AS __kumo_order_1__, "USER_ID" AS __kumo_order_2__, "PRODUCT_ID" AS __kumo_order_3__, "QUANTITY" AS __kumo_order_4__, "ORDERED_AT" AS __kumo_order_5__, "ORDER_ID", "USER_ID", "PRODUCT_ID", "QUANTITY", "ORDERED_AT" FROM "<redacted:parity_snowflake_database>"."PARITY_SHOP"."ORDERS" ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(*), MIN("ORDERED_AT"), MAX("ORDERED_AT"), COUNT("ORDERED_AT")
FROM "<redacted:parity_snowflake_database>"."PARITY_SHOP"."ORDERS"

SELECT HASH("PRODUCT_ID", "CATEGORY", "PRICE") AS __kumo_order_0__, "PRODUCT_ID" AS __kumo_order_1__, "CATEGORY" AS __kumo_order_2__, "PRICE" AS __kumo_order_3__, "PRODUCT_ID", "CATEGORY", "PRICE" FROM "<redacted:parity_snowflake_database>"."PARITY_SHOP"."PRODUCTS" ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4 LIMIT 1000

SELECT HASH("USER_ID", "AGE", "COUNTRY") AS __kumo_order_0__, "USER_ID" AS __kumo_order_1__, "AGE" AS __kumo_order_2__, "COUNTRY" AS __kumo_order_3__, "USER_ID", "AGE", "COUNTRY" FROM "<redacted:parity_snowflake_database>"."PARITY_SHOP"."USERS" ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4 LIMIT 1000

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN("ORDERED_AT") as min_date,
  MAX("ORDERED_AT") as max_date
FROM "<redacted:parity_snowflake_database>"."PARITY_SHOP"."ORDERS"

SELECT "CATEGORY", "PRODUCT_ID"
FROM "<redacted:parity_snowflake_database>"."PARITY_SHOP"."PRODUCTS"
WHERE "PRODUCT_ID" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY MD5_NUMBER_LOWER64('7:' || TO_VARCHAR("PRODUCT_ID")), "PRODUCT_ID", "CATEGORY"
LIMIT 10000

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "PRICE", "PRODUCT_ID"
FROM TMP
JOIN "<redacted:parity_snowflake_database>"."PARITY_SHOP"."PRODUCTS"
  ON "PRODUCT_ID" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "PRICE", "PRODUCT_ID"

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value[0]::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__,
    f.value[1]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_END_TIME__,
    f.value[2]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "ORDERED_AT", "QUANTITY", "ORDER_ID", "PRODUCT_ID", "USER_ID"
FROM TMP
JOIN "<redacted:parity_snowflake_database>"."PARITY_SHOP"."ORDERS"
  ON "PRODUCT_ID" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ORDERED_AT" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ORDERED_AT" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE "ORDERED_AT" <= ?
  AND "ORDERED_AT" > ?
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
  ORDER BY "ORDERED_AT" DESC, "ORDER_ID", "PRODUCT_ID", "QUANTITY", "USER_ID"
) <= 32
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ORDERED_AT" DESC, "ORDER_ID", "PRODUCT_ID", "QUANTITY", "USER_ID"

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "AGE", "COUNTRY", "USER_ID"
FROM TMP
JOIN "<redacted:parity_snowflake_database>"."PARITY_SHOP"."USERS"
  ON "USER_ID" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "AGE", "COUNTRY", "USER_ID"
